==Purpose of template==
This template allows you to get the Ajah's color as a CSS value.

<span style="color : {{Ajah Color|blue}}">Blue</span> <span style="color : {{Ajah Color|green}}">Green</span> <span style="color : {{Ajah Color|yellow}}">Yellow</span> <span style="color : {{Ajah Color|red}}">Red</span> <span style="color : {{Ajah Color|white}}">White</span> <span style="color : {{Ajah Color|grey}}">Grey</span> <span style="color : {{Ajah Color|brown}}">Brown</span> "<span style="color : {{Ajah Color|black}}">Black</span>"

==How to use==
<pre>{{Ajah Color|[ajah]}}</pre>

==Examples==
<pre>{{Ajah Color}}</pre>
{{Ajah Color}}

<pre>{{Ajah Color|blue}}</pre>
{{Ajah Color|blue}}

<pre>{{Ajah Color|green}}</pre>
{{Ajah Color|green}}

<pre>{{Ajah Color|yellow}}</pre>
{{Ajah Color|yellow}}

<pre>{{Ajah Color|red}}</pre>
{{Ajah Color|red}}

<pre>{{Ajah Color|white}}</pre>
{{Ajah Color|white}}

<pre>{{Ajah Color|grey}}</pre>
{{Ajah Color|grey}}

<pre>{{Ajah Color|brown}}</pre>
{{Ajah Color|brown}}

<pre>{{Ajah Color|black}}</pre>
{{Ajah Color|black}}

<pre>{{Ajah Color|nonsense}}</pre>
{{Ajah Color|nonsense}}
